runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days?

answer.text:
The passages don't name a single memo, so I've covered each one that sets a 180-day deadline. Several of them require the same thing: a compliance plan.

- **M-25-21 (April 2025):** Within 180 days of issuance, each agency must submit a plan to OMB and post it publicly, or post a written determination that it does not use and does not expect to use covered AI. Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum. OMB will provide templates for these plans.
- **M-24-10 (March 2024):** The same compliance-plan requirement appears here. Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI.
- **M-25-22 (April 2025):** The consolidated action table lists a 180-day deadline for agencies to achieve full compliance with the guidance of this memorandum. The table text is badly garbled in the extraction, so I'd confirm this against the original PDF.

The passages don't say whether M-25-21 replaces M-24-10 on this point, so I can't tell which deadline governs if both apply. The M-24-18 passage shown does not contain a 180-day requirement.
